prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Tobias Reyne after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Booking platform for fitness studios
client: Pulsebox Studios
client_industry: fitness
start: 2020-03
end: 2020-08
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Next.js
- Node.js
- PostgreSQL
- Prisma
- Stripe
implied_skills:
- multi-tenancy
- subscription billing
built: A white-label class booking app where each studio gets its own subdomain, timetable
  and memberships.
metrics:
- 64 studios onboarded in 6 months
- 71% checkout conversion

The review is from: Pulsebox Studios
Rating: 4.8 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- Focus mostly on speed and deadlines; do not just repeat the project summary.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "multi-tenancy", "subscription billing".
text: Tobias moved quickly and kept the project on track from start to finish. He delivered the booking platform on schedule and was responsive when we needed changes along the way. We were able to onboard 64 studios in 6 months, and checkout conversion ended up at 71%, which was a strong result for us.
